name: Chaotic Spell Lash
body:
School evocation [force]; Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./level)
Effect magical whip
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A shimmering, magical whip appears in your hand, as multihued as a rainbow. When used to strike an enemy’s touch AC as a standard action, it randomly inflicts a condition on that enemy for one round. The whip inflicts a different condition every time it successfully strikes an enemy, even if it strikes the same enemy more than once.

Roll d10 and consult the list of conditions below:

Nauseated
Frightened
Entangled
Blinded
Confused
Fatigued
Shaken
Sickened
Exhausted
Stunned
